name: careflow-ai
description: CareFlow AI monorepo: appointment booking and clinic management foundation.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @careflow/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @careflow/api" "npm run dev -w @careflow/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @careflow/shared && npm run dev -w @careflow/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @careflow/shared && npm run build -w @careflow/api && npm run build -w @careflow/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @careflow/shared && npm run db:generate -w @careflow/api
